flimber ˈflɪmbə ˈflɪmbər flimber flimbers flimbered

verb

1
to smooth clay with a wooden tool 用木工具抹平黏土
flimber something
She flimbered the bowl carefully.她小心地抹平了碗。
2
informalto work slowly 慢吞吞地干活
flimber aboutto waste time 浪费时间
flimber downto become calmer 平静下来

noun

countable
a wooden smoothing tool 木制抹平工具
